limitations: The prototype is proposed evidence and is not wired into production selection.
Only the declared two-by-two parameter family is exhaustively checked.
Inputs are deliberately constrained to contain all four occupancy states.

parameters.input_dependency: all fixtures contain 00, 10, 01, and 11 and use input colors 1/9, so all four parameter settings are distinguishable

state-00_color-2.source:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let ((h (/ (rows g) 2)))
             (build-grid h
                         w
                         (r c)
                         (if (and (zero? (at g r c)) (zero? (at g (+ r h) c))) 2 0))))))
